news.headline: NeurAxis Announces Medical Coverage Policy Milestone, Expanding Access to Over 18 Million Additional Covered Lives
news.summary: A major national health insurer added medical policy coverage for PENFS across multiple states, representing roughly 18 million health plan members. This pushes NeurAxis's total national coverage footprint for IB-Stim past 120 million covered lives.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
news.summary: NeurAxis will give a webcast presentation on September 29, 2026 at 11:45 a.m. ET and host one-on-one investor meetings September 29-30 at the virtual Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference.

news.headline: NeurAxis Presents at IAccess Alpha Fall Investment Conference: Payer Wins Drive Growth
news.summary: Management highlighted H1 2026 revenue growth of 94% to $3.5 million with gross margin at 86%, and reported nearly 30 medical policy coverages reaching more than 100 million lives, including Anthem and Blue Cross Blue Shield plans.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% year-over-year to $1.93 million, with unit deliveries up 60% YoY and gross margin improving to 85.9% from 83.6%, driven by the new Category I CPT code for PENFS.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis secured additional medical policy coverage for PENFS representing over 500,000 covered lives, continuing its rollout of payer wins following the January 2026 Category I CPT code effective date.

catalysts.label: Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
catalysts.detail: Virtual webcast presentation on Sept 29 at 11:45 a.m. ET plus one-on-one investor meetings Sept 29-30.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: No specific date announced yet; prior quarters reported mid-quarter-plus-one-month (Q1 on May 12, Q2 on Aug 11), suggesting an early-to-mid November release.

catalysts.label: Nationwide Medicaid EPSDT / CPT code 64567 fee-schedule rollout
catalysts.detail: State-by-state Medicaid fee-schedule adoption of the new Category I CPT code for PENFS continues to expand reimbursement access alongside commercial payer wins.

catalysts.label: Adult IBS / functional abdominal pain multi-site RCT readout
catalysts.detail: Data from the ongoing adult indication trial would support label expansion beyond the current pediatric/adolescent clearance.

catalysts.label: Series B preferred stock 8.5% coupon expiration/conversion window
catalysts.detail: Contractual milestone on the company's Series B preferred stock terms that could affect dilution and capital structure.

pulse: NeurAxis continues to post triple-digit revenue growth (Q2 2026 up 116% YoY) as the new Category I CPT code drives a wave of payer wins, with total covered lives now exceeding 120 million after the September 16 milestone announcement. Near-term catalysts are investor-facing (Lytham Partners conference Sept 29-30) rather than clinical, with Q3 earnings still unscheduled and the adult IBS trial readout still well out on the horizon. Sentiment remains bullish, with Craig-Hallum maintaining a Buy rating and $13 price target, though the stock stays volatile on a thin float.
